title: Cool Materials
description: Add way too many things into your world with COOLMATERIALS!
body:
Add way too many things into your world with COOLMATERIALS!
This mod is made to add cool materials. This was made with MCreator and currently has bananzo and void crystal stuff.I hope you enjoy it! Bananzo stuff:
Bananzo ore, tools and armour that you can craft. And the
bananzo wood set, includes trees, planks and 2 boats, alongside all other things that you can get from wood. Bananzo is one of the cool materials I am adding, it is based on bananas.
Void Crystal stuff:
Void Crystal ore, OP tools and armour.
Void Crystal is very rare however, and only spawns in the End.
